meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 每个群组多了一个可选后端：OpenAI 的 Codex。只有当你把某个群组的 provider 切换为 codex 并重启后，该群组的规划、工具调用、会话历史等才由 Codex 接管；否则仍由 Claude 处理。切换是管理员在宿主机上的操作。
howto.when: 当你把某个群组的 provider 改为 codex 并重启该群组后，该群组的新对话由 Codex 接管；若把 DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER 设为 codex，则此后新建的群组默认用 Codex。

say.text: 把群组 100 的 agent 换成 Codex
设置新建群组默认用 Codex
检查 Codex 是否已正确安装

howto.what_en: After install, each group can use OpenAI's Codex as its agent backend. Unless you explicitly switch a group to codex and restart it, Claude remains the default. Once switched, Codex handles planning, tools, MCP, and history.
howto.when_en: It takes effect when you run `ncl groups config update --id <group-id> --provider codex` then restart that group. Or set DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER=codex to make new groups default to Codex.

say_en.text: Switch group 100 to Codex as its agent.
say_en.note: Runs the switch command and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Make new groups default to Codex.
Check whether Codex is correctly installed.
